text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOO! Everyone did so great~!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ... What incredible cheers...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone really enjoyed it. Falco and the 
others' all-out effort reached them.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just before the Winning Live, Smart Falcon 
fell silent. Was it nerves before the big 
stage, or—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ! You are...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for bothering you before the 
concert. And... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh... what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text:
You're an "Umadol"... right? I know you've 
been working hard to hype up the dirt 
tracks through your activities.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text:
So today, more people showed up than ever 
before, and...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text:
"—The hype was like nothing I've ever 
experienced before. I'm so, so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text:
Um, that's all. Now then... let's enjoy 
the best stage ever!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Mm-hmm☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. But, but...—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... *haaah*...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Falco is staying totally 
focused!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—I'm off, Trainer! I'll sing and dance 
with all my heart and soul☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day's Winning Live became one of the 
most wonderful and memorable dirt track 
live performances I've ever known—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, after everything was over, Smart 
Falcon came back looking..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —It hurts so much.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's... really frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm super duper frustrated! Uuu~~……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having achieved great results in both the 
race and the Live, she had no reason to 
feel frustrated."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Because I figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
――"This" is the very top you can aim for 
on dirt, they say.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That moment just now... During the 
concert, I was so, so happy."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Out of all the stages I've stood on, that 
was definitely one of the most electric!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still... I'm not on top of everything yet!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And yet... everyone's satisfied with just 
this.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text:
"—The hype was like nothing I've ever 
experienced before. I'm so, so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—That's not true. We can all climb much, 
much higher together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know we could create that kind of wild 
excitement like at the Arima Kinen too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason for her frustration. That 
was... something only she could feel, 
having experienced the top stages of both 
turf and dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Falco's just gotta do it after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Both you and that girl told me that my 
Umadol activities led to where I am today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Then if Falco just tries even harder, I 
should definitely be able to reach even 
greater heights, right?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"What I aim for must truly be the 'top' of 
everything...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reaching the "top" has been her goal since 
the very beginning. But right now, it 
looks as though she's putting too much 
pressure on herself.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Why? Falco is fired up, you know!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Trainer, I want you to tell 
me we'll give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is completely serious. In that case, 
as her Trainer, all I can do is keep a 
close eye on her and lend a hand whenever 
needed.
choice_data_list: Just promise me you won't overdo it.

Just please don't push yourself too hard, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know! Self-management is basic for an 
Umadol, after all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san, onwards to the next! 
Let's think about the next race!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I won't have the title of 
"Year-End Finale." Falco will have to hype 
up the crowd even more than today all on 
her own!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was one proposal for our next target 
race. A GⅠ race open only to Senior-class 
racers. And that was...
choice_data_list: Then, the February Stakes sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...That's a GⅠ race held at Tokyo 
Racecourse, right?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse where they also run the 
Nippon Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are two dirt GⅠ races in the Twinkle 
Series: the February Stakes and the 
Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it garners far more attention 
than other dirt GⅠs held at local 
racecourses.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Alright. Let's run the February Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon carried an air of intense 
determination. And so, her first goal for 
the Senior Class was set on the February 
Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"A chance for Falco to stand out...! 
Then—I just gotta do it!"
